overview_description.description: WOW DECOR is a UAE-based interior design and fit-out company that offers residential and commercial interior solutions, including space planning, custom furniture, renovation, décor, and turnkey fit-out services. The company works on projects such as villas, apartments, offices, retail spaces, and hospitality interiors, combining design consultation with project execution and furnishing services. Its offerings also include bespoke woodwork, lighting, wall treatments, and home styling aimed at functional and aesthetic interior enhancement.

product.name: Custom-Made Luxury Kitchens
product.description: Design and manufacture of personalized kitchen units tailored to client specifications using high-quality German materials.

product.name: Custom-Made Closets and Wardrobes
product.description: Creation of bespoke closets and wardrobes designed to fit specific spaces and storage needs with customizable materials and styles.

product.name: Custom-Made Vanity Units
product.description: Design and construction of personalized bathroom vanity units with integrated sinks, mirrors, and storage tailored to client preferences.

product.name: Custom-Made TV and Media Units
product.description: Bespoke TV and media furniture designed to fit living spaces, maximizing storage and enhancing audiovisual organization.

product.name: Custom-Made Furniture
product.description: Personalized furniture solutions for various rooms including living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and home offices, tailored to client specifications.
